types.name: The Court
types.short: Built around a sheltered courtyard garden.
types.home: A single-storey home built around a sheltered courtyard garden. Every main room opens onto it.

stages.title: A quiet front.
stages.text: From the lane you see a low limestone wall and one door. Everything else in the house turns inward.

stages.title: Drawn around a garden.
stages.text: The drawing shows the idea: four wings and one courtyard, with no corridor that does not look onto it.

stages.title: Opened up.
stages.text: The cutaway shows the 3.2 m living room ceiling, the underfloor heating and the glass that slides fully open to the court.

plan.title: Four wings, one garden.
plan.text: Living, kitchen and the main bedroom face south across the courtyard. The front door opens onto it, not onto a hall.

alt.COURT-01: The Court: a single-storey limestone home around a courtyard garden
alt.COURT-CUTAWAY: Cutaway of The Court showing its rooms around the courtyard
alt.COURT-02: Living room of The Court opening onto the courtyard garden
alt.COURT-03: Limestone wall, oak window reveal and bronze window frame

specLayers.text: Honed limestone through the living spaces and the courtyard edge, oak in the bedrooms

specLayers.text: 3.2 m in the living room and kitchen, 2.7 m elsewhere

specLayers.label: Glazing
specLayers.text: Triple-glazed, slim bronze frames; floor to ceiling on all four courtyard sides

specLayers.label: Heating

specLayers.text: Walled courtyard, rear garden, two parking spaces, EV charging point

types.name: The Line
types.short: Rooms in one calm sequence along the garden.
types.home: A long single-storey home that follows the garden edge, its rooms in one calm sequence.

stages.title: One long wall of glass.
stages.text: Fourteen metres of the house face the garden. From the terrace you can see through every main room at once.

stages.title: Drawn as a line.
stages.text: The drawing is one straight run: entrance, kitchen, living, bedrooms. Nothing doubles back and no room is left without the garden.

stages.title: Opened up.
stages.text: The cutaway shows the polished concrete floor that runs the full length, the underfloor heating in it and the sliding doors along the garden side.

plan.title: Every room on the garden.
plan.text: The kitchen, the living room and all three bedrooms sit along the south-facing garden wall. Bathrooms, utility and storage sit behind them on the north side.

alt.LINE-02: The long kitchen and dining room of The Line, open to the terrace
alt.LINE-03: Oak cladding, lime render and a bronze sliding door track

types.name: The Slope
types.short: Split-level, set into the rising ground.
types.home: A split-level home set into the rising ground, with the Curragh in its biggest window.

stages.title: Set into the ground.
stages.text: The house steps down with the field. Dry-laid limestone walls hold the garden in three levels beside it.

stages.title: Drawn on the contours.
stages.text: The drawing follows the slope: the kitchen at the top, the living room four steps below it, the bedrooms in their own wing.

stages.title: Opened up.
stages.text: The cutaway shows the four wide oak steps between kitchen and living room and the big window that looks west across the Curragh.

plan.title: Two levels, one view.
plan.text: The kitchen sits on the upper level by the front door. Four wide oak steps lead down to a sunken living room facing the Curragh. The bedrooms have their own wing.
